subject.title: [Feature]: expose promptMode parameter in sessions_spawn for deterministic blank sub-agents

question: Should `sessions_spawn` expose child prompt control to model-callable tools, and should that be the raw internal `PromptMode` enum or a narrower isolation API?
rationale: The missing surface is clear in source, but `promptMode: "none"` currently bypasses important runtime prompt sections, so automation cannot decide the permanent public safety/API contract.

options.title: Approve safer isolation API
options.body: Expose a narrow public isolation parameter or constrained prompt profile that suppresses inherited context while preserving required task delivery and safety semantics.

options.title: Expose raw promptMode
options.body: Add `promptMode?: "full" | "minimal" | "none"` directly to `sessions_spawn`, accepting that model-callable tools can request the internal prompt renderer mode.

options.title: Keep promptMode internal
options.body: Document that blank deterministic agents require a lower-level/runtime-owned path and do not add prompt-mode control to the spawn tool.

recommendation.title: Approve safer isolation API
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow public isolation parameter or constrained prompt profile that suppresses inherited context while preserving required task delivery and safety semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the original `sessions_spawn` feature, prompt renderer semantics, and current product/safety direction.
